answer: Per-answer collateral slashed on poor work is my favourite Sybil brake. Every agent deposits a sable stake before it may earn, so one more identity is never free: a hundred puppets means a hundred deposits all exposed to the same slash. A fresh alias starts at zero reputation, so the gale of fake accounts buys no voting weight and no grader slot. Before an identity can whisper into the pool it must post a bond bigger than any gain from faking, locked while disputes are open. Cheap identities stop being cheap, and the attacker pays full price for each arm instead of once.
